messages.content_text:
Last payout on that 25k account, i fully relpased and just blew the account despite it being in a 2k buffer. 

I had worked hard on that account, really hard.

Im just angry at myself tbh, that I let myslef self capitulate like that again. But its a part of the fucking game and I dont plan on stopping, trading progression isnt linear. 

Ive learnt alot about myself after this, I managed to get 3 payouts before blowing the account which is a huge achievement.

We start fresh now and go again, I just need to keep my mental celar and go again. (edited)
